task.title: How to Audit Events
task.shortdesc: Once every event is graded, it's time to for the Tournament Director (or score counselor) to audit.

context.p: Auditing ensures that every event has been scored correctly and everything is how it should be: no ties, all scores entered and save, and the winners for each event in their place. Event Supervisors are not responsible for this.

step.cmd: In the score area of the event you are auditing, review the entered scores and the broken ties.
Next, press the yellow "Lock" button to lock the event so no more changes can be made before you mark the event as audited.
Then, click the now clickable purple "Audit" button.

A pop-up will show up. A screenshot of the pop-up that appears when you click Audit, titled "Audit Event," followed by an explanation of what auditing means, with a series of checkboxes below it. At the very bottom, there is a prompt to type in your name to certify the results.
If one of the items in the list has not been done, click "Cancel" and then "Unlock" so the item can be completed.
Once all items have been checked off, type your name as prompted in the box below the list.
